name: Long glide
description: A very long, patient blend in which the tempo itself travels: over the whole overlap the beat slowly glides from the old song's tempo to the new song's, so the change of pace is felt rather than heard. The songs cross-fade at constant loudness, swap basslines halfway, and the old song's treble recedes in its last quarter. Made for songs a few BPM apart that deserve a long, deep mix, for example in a warm-up or a closing set.
author: Muisc
